messages.author: affa918ed63b6275
messages.subject: Re: version on cran
parts:
David, yes, that's right, thanks.
Spinola, here is the way:

> install.packages("ggplot2", dep = TRUE, type = "source")

But this requires compilation by yourself, and hence sometimes we may
fail to compile.
e.g. in my env I cannot compile SparseM that is required by ggplot2.

So I just want to know if this status is temporal, as the R moved
2.15.0, or something wrong happens with ggplot2.
